// diagnostic

E2415

Union `{Union}` can't be decoded — `{A}` and `{B}` share wire shape `{shape}`.

What

Union `{Union}` can't be decoded — `{A}` and `{B}` share wire shape `{shape}`.

Why

Anonymous-union decode (D-UNIONTYPE1=A) picks a member by primary wire shape; two members with the same shape would force an arbitrary declaration order.

Fix

use a named enum with an explicit tag, or change the members so each has a distinct wire shape.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2415: tests/ui/union_codable_ambiguous.stderr.

Error [E2415]: union `Char | String` can't be decoded — `Char (one character)` and `String (text)` share wire shape `Text`
  --> tests/ui/union_codable_ambiguous.jet:6:5
    |
  6 |     value: String | Char
    |     ^^^^^
 Why: anonymous-union decode picks a member by wire shape; two members with the same shape would force an arbitrary order
 Fix: use a named enum with an explicit tag, or change the members so each has a distinct wire shape
